Independently verify the exact quote-alignment contract WITHOUT seeing
implementation or real source texts. Return JSON {approve:boolean,reason:string,
cases:[{input:object,expected:object} or {input:object,expected_error:"ValueError"}]}.
Propose8 tiny distinct fictional cases covering plain matching, overlapping hits,
casefold expansion U+00DF versus ss/s, fullwidth NFKC and collapsed whitespace with
ORIGINAL spans, same snippet in two source IDs, absent/empty lists, duplicate IDs,
and blank or malformed queries. Follow the precise per-code-point rule, original
coordinates and output order. No real paper snippets. No implementation supplied.

{"operation": {"name": "diagnose_unicode_span_misalignment", "description": "Generic Unicode-aware all-occurrence quote alignment with exact original source offsets.", "when_to_use": "When source quotes need exact original character coordinates, all hits and explicit absent-query rejection.", "limitations": "Literal source anchoring only; not semantic entailment or medical correctness.", "semantic_preprocessor": null, "code_contract": {"input_schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"sources": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"source_id": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}, "text": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["source_id", "text"], "additionalProperties": false}, "maxItems": 20}, "queries": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"query_id": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}, "text": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}}, "required": ["query_id", "text"], "additionalProperties": false}, "maxItems": 30}}, "required": ["sources", "queries"], "additionalProperties": false}, "output_schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"queries": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"query_id": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 200}, "matches": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"source_id": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 200}, "start": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0}, "end": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1}, "quote": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 2000}}, "required": ["source_id", "start", "end", "quote"], "additionalProperties": false}, "maxItems": 200}}, "required": ["query_id", "matches"], "additionalProperties": false}, "maxItems": 30}, "unsupported_query_ids": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 200}, "maxItems": 30}}, "required": ["queries", "unsupported_query_ids"], "additionalProperties": false}, "algorithm": "Align every query against ALL original source strings without inventing evidence.
Input is exactly {sources:[{source_id:string,text:string}],queries:[{query_id:string,text:string}]}.
IDs are nonempty, unique within their lists. All texts are strings; queries cannot
be empty/whitespace-only. Normalize each ORIGINAL Unicode code point separately
using unicodedata.normalize('NFKC',char).casefold(), concatenate the results, and
collapse each whitespace run to ONE ASCII space. Do NOT trim, remove punctuation,
translate, infer aliases, equate different dash characters or normalize across
code-point boundaries. Apply the SAME normalization to each query.
Find ALL substring occurrences including overlaps, in source input order then
ascending ORIGINAL start. Map each normalized occurrence back to its original
zero-based Python Unicode code-point [start,end) span, NOT UTF-8 bytes or tokens.
Emit only matches whose WHOLE original span, normalized by the same rule, equals
the normalized query. This rejects partial hits inside a casefold expansion:
source U+00DF matches query ss, but NOT query s. Collapse duplicate original spans.
quote MUST equal original_text[start:end] exactly, including original case and
whitespace. Preserve separate source IDs. Output queries in input query order,
matches:[{source_id,start,end,quote}], and unsupported_query_ids in input order
for exactly those queries with no matches. Empty lists are allowed. Never use
semantic similarity as a match. Preserve inputs. Reject malformed objects, extra
keys, wrong types, duplicate/empty IDs and blank queries with ValueError. Ordinary
allowed Python standard modules including unicodedata are sufficient; no files,
network, external packages, model calls or hardcoded source/query values.
Qwen compiled algorithm:
1. Validate input structure: Ensure 'sources' and 'queries' arrays exist, IDs are non-empty and unique within their lists, and query texts are non-empty/non-whitespace. Raise ValueError for any violation. 2. Define normalization function: For each character in a string, apply NFKC normalization followed by casefolding. Concatenate results. Collapse consecutive whitespace characters into a single ASCII space. Do not trim leading/trailing whitespace or remove punctuation. 3. Preprocess sources: For each source, store the original text and generate its normalized version using the defined function. 4. Preprocess queries: For each query, generate its normalized version using the defined function. 5. Search and Map: For each query in input order, iterate through all sources in input order. Search for the normalized query string within the normalized source string to find all overlapping start indices. 6. Span Reconstruction: For each normalized match start index, map it back to the original source text's zero-based Unicode code-point start index. Determine the original end index such that the slice [start, end) from the original text, when normalized, exactly equals the normalized query. 7. Verification: Verify that the normalized version of original_text[start:end] strictly equals the normalized query. Reject matches where the normalized span does not match (e.g., partial hits inside casefold expansions). 8. Deduplication: Remove duplicate [source_id, start, end] spans for the same query. 9. Output Construction: Compile matches for each query preserving input order. Include 'unsupported_query_ids' for queries with zero matches.
